title: Correlated disagreement probability
statement: For $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, the correlated disagreement probability is the expectation, under the correlated pair distribution with parameter $\rho$, of the indicator that $f(x)\ne f(y)$.
